'''M'lay Loto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who was the mother of [[Aimi Loto]]. She disappeared many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
